IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PROD alert — spike in 5xx for /v1/embeddings in us-east-1 (REQ_RATE window 1m). Alert group: routing-fallback. Thread created 2154321987

Maya (oncall): I'm seeing the pager. Investigating now — can someone confirm if any recent pin/rollouts touched embed models in us-east-1?

Jae (sre): Noted. I can see a surge of `500` logs at the runtime router: `fallback_to_variant` path executed repeatedly. Snapshot: `requested_route=embed-lite-v2, pinned_version=redwood-chat-4-instruct_v3, fallback_target=redwood-chat-4-instruct_v3 -> handler=chat_instruct_handler -> error=unsupported_input_type`

Omar (eng-runtime): Whoa. That pinned_version looks wrong for the embed route. It appears a pin operation updated the routing alias used by the embed route and pointed it at a chat/instruct variant. Likely cause of `unsupported_input_type` leading to 500s.

Maya (oncall): @Omar can you confirm which pin changed and when? Priya, do we have customer reports?

Omar (eng-runtime): Checking audit logs... `PATCH /routing/pins/embed-lite` at 2154321180 by `deploy-bot` with version `redwood-chat-4-instruct_v3` (previous: `embed-lite-v2_v27`). That patch propagated to us-east-1 routing table at 2154321205.

Priya (cs): Acme Corp reported embedding failures starting ~02:20UTC, matching timeline. They're seeing empty embedding arrays and 5xx on our side. They flagged it to their repo. cc:account team.

Claire (product): Any chance this was an intentional pin? Seems risky to pin a chat variant into an embed route.

ops-bot: rollback-trigger-check — source=deploy-bot, run_book=pin-rollback, prechecks=ok.

Maya (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) revert the pin -> point embed route back to `embed-lite-v2_v27` 2) set a temporary routing-policy guard to block incompatible variants 3) contact Acme with ETA. Omar / Jae handle runtime rollback, I will own comms.

Omar (eng-runtime): Rolling rollback now: `/api/internal/pins/revert?route=embed-lite&to_version=embed-lite-v2_v27` -> returned `202 accepted`, job id `rb-2154321302`. Pushing to us-east-1.

Jae (sre): I'm tailing logs and metrics. Before rollback: 5xx rate ~12%. After revert request submitted: see initial drop, still some residual errors due to in-flight requests and cached routing entries. Flushing routing cache on edge nodes now: `curl -X POST https://edge-internal/us-east-1/cache/flush?route=embed-lite` -> OK.

Maya (oncall): @Priya please send templated message to Acme: short apology, mitigation steps, ETA 15m. Keep me looped.

Priya (cs): Sending now. "We're investigating and have rolled back a recent pin that caused embedding failures. We expect full recovery within 15 minutes. Will update." :email:

Omar (eng-runtime): Cache flush finished. Metrics: error rate dropped to 1.2% and falling. Tail logs show `pinned_version=embed-lite-v2_v27` now routing successfully. Sample successful response: ```{ "request_id": "r-abc123", "embeddings": [[0.001, -0.02, ...]] }```

Jae (sre): I'm keeping the circuit on the embed route: temporary rate-limit to 200rps and fail-open to a safe embed fallback (embed-lite-v2_v26) if error spikes above 5%. That should prevent customer impact if another bad pin happens.

Maya (oncall): Great. Marking incident as mitigated. Changing status -> MONITORED. Need follow-ups: 1) postmortem, 2) add validation to pin API to block incompatible variant types, 3) add alert that ties pin changes to routing errors, 4) review deploy-bot permissions. Assign owners?

Omar (eng-runtime): I'll own #2 (validation in pin API) and #4 (deploy-bot permission review). ETA EOD.

Jae (sre): I'll own #3 and the alert tune-up. Also will run a stress test after new alert in staging. ETA 48h.

Priya (cs): I'll follow up with Acme with a post-incident summary once we have a root cause writeup.

Claire (product): Please ensure the pin UI displays variant compatibility (embed vs gen vs chat) prominently. I'll add a small design task.

Maya (oncall): Quick notes for the postmortem: cause = `deploy-bot` pin operation updated embed route to a chat/instruct variant (human error + missing validation); impact = increased 5xx for /v1/embeddings in us-east-1, customer-visible outages (Acme); detection = runtime 5xx alert; mitigation = rollback pin, cache flush, temporary rate limits.

ops-bot: incident_autoclose-check scheduled for 2154326250. If no regression, will close with severity P2.

Maya (oncall): Thx team. Leaving monitoring on for 1h. If anyone sees any oddness ping here. :thumbsup:

Omar (eng-runtime): After-action: I pushed a quick guard in the pin service that compares model taxonomy at assign-time. It defaults to `reject` if types mismatch and emits audit event. Temporary hotfix deployed to staging, will promote to prod after code review.``
